title: Audit every import path for idempotency (bank sync, statement/CSV import, backup restore, prod import): same input twice = no new rows; tests for each
description: Owner 2026-11-27: 'every import in the system should be idempotent'. One duplicate (-800,00 on Empresa) came from the statement import matching a payee by case; fixed on tk/budget-pzrk.
notes:
Audited all import paths. Verdicts: bank sync (import_id provider:external + connection_transactions shadow, per budget since 0106) idempotent; /bulk (generated YNAB:<milli>:<date>:<payee>:<occ> or the file's import_id, partial unique index among live rows, plus statement-text match at same amount+date under any key) idempotent; backup restore replace-in-one-transaction idempotent; prod import replace-scoped idempotent and now tested; repeat generation idempotent (unique (rule_id, occurrence_date)). One NOT idempotent case found: /bulk dedupe reads filter NOT deleted, so deleting an imported row then re-importing the same file re-adds it — bank sync skips tombstones instead. Product decision, filed as budget-z6ob under budget-4u4d; documented in docs/evidence/import-idempotency/REPORT.md. New: api/scripts/import-prod/sink.test.ts (plan run twice, identical counts+fingerprints; one changed memo moves the fingerprint; mutation-verified against users_pkey) and the snapshot fixture moved to api/scripts/import-prod/fixture.ts shared with map.test.ts.
Orchestrator: accepted after independent review + checks; merged into tk/budget-4u4d-integration at 3ce3f0d (shared 232, api 1835/2 skip/0 fail, client 1708, admin 20). Left ready-to-review for the owner, who merges to main.
